A small sticker/logo is visible on the front control panel (photo 0) but the text is too small/blurry to read
Two round control knobs with red/yellow markings on the front panel (photo 0)
Power cord visible running from the unit up to the bracket area
Background shows other salon equipment (a hood dryer, a UV/magnifying lamp) that are not part of this listing
No photo shows the unit powered on, steaming, or the water tank removed/filled

risks.risk: Water tank or seals could be cracked/leaking

risks.if_unproven: priced as steamer head only, bracket excluded

risks.risk: Internal timer/control knobs may be faulty

risks.risk: Electrical cord or plug condition (fraying, exposed wire) not visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug and full cord length

proof_requests: Video of the steamer powered on, producing steam, with knobs being adjusted
Close-up of the water tank removed and filled, checked for leaks
Clear photo of the brand/model sticker on the control panel
Confirmation and photo of whether the wall bracket is included
Close-up of the power cord and plug
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a wall-mounted hair steamer, but none of the seller's condition claims (new, lightly used, working) are shown in action, so it must be priced at worst case as unproven/not working pending video proof.
